purpose: This file defines the proposed Phase 03 boundary. It is not authorization to generate teacher targets, train, evaluate, or freeze a student.
research_question: For each EN-to-VI and VI-to-EN direction, can a Student trained on one sequence-level target generated by the frozen EnViT5 Teacher for every eligible IT Train source retain sufficient translation quality, technical-term correctness, and implementation readiness to be frozen as the Main-Core for Phase 4?

generation.policy: Phase 02 used the model-derived GenerationConfig with max_length=512. Because the local checkpoint has no generation_config.json, the effective greedy-decoding values from Transformers 4.57.6 are now explicit in each experiment record; they are retained, not tuned using Phase 03 validation data.
generation.target_normalization: Remove only one exact leading output_control_prefix and one following delimiter whitespace when present; store the remaining text unchanged.

student.selection_reason: The Student initialization is fixed in the technical configuration so that each direction has one reproducible starting checkpoint. It is not a second student-training branch or a claim that it is the smallest possible model.

input_length_policy.rule: Teacher generation and Student training use the eligible rows for their direction. The original Phase 01 IT Train file remains unchanged.

knowledge_distillation.selection_rule: Sequence-level KD is approved for the Teacher/Student pair. An experiment record must still freeze all execution settings before generation or training.
knowledge_distillation.training_data_rule: For each direction's eligible IT Train source defined by the approved input-length policy, Teacher generates exactly one text target using the frozen Phase 02 Teacher runtime. Student trains only on source and that unedited Teacher target after its full target-integrity scan passes; the original reference is not mixed into the training label.
knowledge_distillation.teacher_runtime_rule: Reuse the frozen Phase 02 Teacher checkpoint, language controls and generation settings, including max_length=512. Record every applied GenerationConfig value, inference batch size, precision, device and source checksum. Do not tune decoding using validation.
integrity_requirements: target row count equals the direction's eligible IT Train row count
every eligible dataset_row_id is present exactly once and every excluded ID is absent
every stored source hash matches IT Train
no validation or prohibited-dataset row ID is present
every target is tokenized without truncation by the Student tokenizer and all over-limit rows are listed
knowledge_distillation.target_rule: Teacher targets are not rewritten, manually post-edited, quality-filtered or regenerated selectively. Integrity checks only detect structural/data-boundary failures.
knowledge_distillation.over_limit_target_rule: Generation completes and targets remain staged. A complete tokenizer scan then reports every target above the Student capacity. Any such row blocks Student training and requires a new approved protocol decision; targets are not truncated, excluded, rewritten or regenerated automatically.

evaluation.comparison: Report each direction and dataset separately against the frozen EnViT5 Teacher to describe quality retained after distillation. This is decision evidence for freezing the Student as Main-Core, not a competition or a claim that knowledge distillation outperforms ordinary student training.
evaluation.main_core_readiness_metadata: Record parameter count and serialized checkpoint size for both Teacher and Student. The Student must be smaller than the Teacher to be a credible Phase 4 optimization input; this metadata does not establish device latency, RAM, or deployment success.
evaluation.manual_review: Use the same 50 sealed Phase 02 IT Validation row IDs. A new Phase 03 sheet records only translation_error, technical_error, and an optional note for the student output.

evidence_contract.write_rule: Completed run directories are immutable. Failed or incomplete work remains in its .running directory and is not evidence.

approval_gates.design_review: Current gate. Review this protocol, workflow, evidence contract, and manual before changing status.
approval_gates.method_selection: Approved: sequence-level KD. The research record states why word/logit and feature KD are excluded from this project scope.
approval_gates.experiment_review: The two draft records in configs/phase03_experiments must be reviewed and approved. They declare run ID, exact teacher/student identities, seed, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, gradient accumulation, epochs, precision, checkpoint ID, integrity behavior and execution device before generation or training.
approval_gates.execution: Only after both approvals may the protocol status become frozen_before_experiments and executable runners be used.

prohibited: executing a KD method before the method-selection record is approved
training a separate non-distilled student baseline unless a new research question and protocol explicitly require it
training on validation or final-evaluation data
sending validation or final-evaluation sources to the teacher
rewriting, filtering, ranking, or post-editing method-specific training data
hyperparameter or decoding selection after observing validation results
weighted composite scores or invented quality thresholds
quantization, export, latency, RAM, Android, STT, or TTS evaluation
